title: Largest 1-Bordered Square
description: Find the largest square subgrid where all four borders consist only of 1s.
pseudocode:
1. R = grid.length, C = grid[0].length
2. hor = zeros(R, C), ver = zeros(R, C)
3. For i in 0..R-1, j in 0..C-1:
4.   if grid[i][j] == 1: hor[i][j] = (j>0 ? hor[i][j-1] : 0) + 1
5.   if grid[i][j] == 1: ver[i][j] = (i>0 ? ver[i-1][j] : 0) + 1
6. For size from min(R, C) down to 1:
7.   For i from 0 to R-size, j from 0 to C-size:
8.     If min(hor[i][j+size-1], hor[i+size-1][j+size-1], ver[i+size-1][j], ver[i+size-1][j+size-1]) >= size: return size*size

steps.note: Calculating horizontal and vertical prefix sums for 1s
Square borders are all >= 2, returning area 4
